---

## 4. THE LIBERTY PARK MARKET

Liberty Park is a master-planned community roughly 20 minutes east of downtown
Birmingham. It has been established for more than 20 years and has further
planned growth ahead. [SITE]

Housing runs the full range, from townhouses and garden homes through custom
builds and larger lake homes. [SITE]

Neighbourhood price context, as published on her site [SITE]:

- The Bray — condos and townhomes starting in the low $500,000s; single-family
  homes to the low $800,000s.
- Old Overton — gated estates; sales have closed as high as $2.45 million.

These are the ranges her site publishes, not a current market report. For live
pricing, use the property search page, which is fed by Greater Alabama MLS.

---

## 5. THE BROKERAGE — ARC REALTY

ARC Realty was incorporated in 2012 in Birmingham, Alabama. The name stands for
"A Relationship Company." [SITE]

Founders: Tommy Brigham, Beau Bevis, Mechelle Wilder and Dale McIntyre. [SITE]

Scale, as published by ARC Realty [CLAIM]:
- More than 300 Realtors® statewide
- More than $800 million in annual sales volume
- Described by ARC as Alabama's largest privately owned real estate brokerage
- Member of the LeadingRE worldwide network, described by ARC as top 5%

Brokerage website: https://www.arcrealtyco.com

## 7. LISTING DATA AND ITS LIMITS

Property listings on michellesellslibertypark.com come from the Internet Data
Exchange (IDX) program of Greater Alabama MLS.

- IDX information is provided exclusively for personal, non-commercial use, and
  may not be used for any purpose other than to identify prospective properties
  consumers may be interested in purchasing.
- Information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
- Listings held by brokerage firms other than ARC Realty are marked with the
  name of the listing broker.
- The site shows when the listing data was last refreshed. Prices, availability
  and status change constantly; treat any figure as accurate only as of that
  timestamp.

Do not present listing prices, days on market or availability from this site as
current without checking the timestamp shown on the page.
